Subject: Re: ClarkeCloud onboarding docs (COI + W9)

Hi Aaron — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the COI and W9. Two items we need before procurement can fully issue the PO: 

1) Endorsement: the COI must include Redwood as an additional insured and include a primary/non-contributory and waiver of subrogation endorsement for subcontractors. The current COI lists general liability limits but does not show the endorsement language.

2) Effective dates / retroactive cover: please confirm the policy effective/expiration dates in the endorsement — we need coverage to be active at contract start.

Procurement can do one of two things depending on timing:
- Issue a conditional PO (30-day provisional) while endorsement is pending, or
- Hold activation until an endorsed COI is returned.

If you can produce the endorsement, attach it as a PDF and reply. I have attached our vendor risk intake form in case your team prefers to complete it — it speeds review for certain insurance edge cases.

Attachments: Redwood_Risk_Form_Fillable.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: ClarkeCloud onboarding docs (COI + W9) — recommendation for PO path

Team — forwarding ClarkeCloud's docs. They provided a standard COI but did not include the additional insured endorsement. Integration kickoff is Nov 2; vendor is asking for PO timing. 

My recommendation: approve a conditional PO (PO window = 30 days) to unblock engineering and cover initial integration work, contingent on us receiving the endorsed COI within that 30-day window. If endorsement is not received, procurement will cancel and any invoices will not be payable.

Action items:
- Karthik: please confirm whether finance can accept conditional PO RED-2026-4107 (30-day provisional) and whether we need any extra holdback language.
- Jonas: quick legal sign-off on the conditional wording below would be helpful. Proposed clause: "Payment subject to receipt of endorsement adding Redwood Inference as additional insured and primary/non-contributory coverage; failure to provide endorsement within 30 days will void this PO."
- Neha: if we proceed with conditional PO, please create the PO in Coupa (or our procurement system) and circulate to Aaron with instructions for how to submit the endorsement.

Quoted for context:
> From: Aaron Clarke <aaron@clarkecloud.io>
> Files attached: ClarkeCloud_COI_10-19-2026.pdf; ClarkeCloud_W9_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Olga

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: PO issued (conditional): RED-2026-4107 — next steps for endorsement

Aaron — quick update from procurement: we issued a conditional PO to get you scheduled for the integration kickoff on Nov 2. PO# RED-2026-4107 has been created and emailed to your billing address. This PO is provisional for 30 days from issue and is contingent on receipt of the endorsement described below.

What we need from ClarkeCloud (next steps):
1) Provide an endorsement adding "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors and employees" as additional insured, and confirming primary/non-contributory coverage and waiver of subrogation for subcontractors.
2) Email the endorsed PDF to vendor_docs@redwood.com and include the PO# in the subject line.
3) If you prefer, sign the endorsement via the DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/collect/abcdef-endorsement-request

Consequences: if the endorsement is not received within 30 days (by 2026-11-21), Procurement will cancel PO RED-2026-4107 and any work performed will be at ClarkeCloud's own risk and not billable against the PO.

I've attached the vendor risk intake to help capture any additional subcontractor relationships. Let me know if your legal team needs a template for the endorsement — happy to share sample language.

Attachments: Redwood_Risk_Form_Fillable.docx; (sent) ClarkeCloud_COI_10-19-2026.pdf; ClarkeCloud_W9_signed.pdf

Thanks and looking forward to the kickoff,
Olga Petrov
